decisions.reason: Defining the NFT mint number as the referral-code metadata source does not change badge milestones, storage, icons, or effects.
The existing message-143 FAQ introduction already states that the NFT mint number is the permanent referral code and appears in NFT metadata; no additional or incomplete MODIFY exists.
The metadata source of a referral code does not alter the reward allocation used when no referral code is supplied.
The referral-code metadata source does not change mint price, founder allocation, referral commission amount, or prize-pool destinations.
Secondary-sale royalty amounts, allocation, visibility, and ticket behavior remain unchanged by the referral-code metadata decision.
Identifying the mint number as the referral code does not change ticket issuance quantities, counters, eligibility windows, or reset behavior.
The Big Block prize amount, winner count, funding sources, and draw trigger are unaffected by the referral-code metadata source.
The Small Block prize amount, winner count, funding sources, and draw condition are unaffected by the referral-code metadata source.
The referral-code metadata decision does not alter Transak, supported fiat payment methods, conversion behavior, or wallet requirements.
The referral-code metadata source has no effect on the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
The prize claim method and Winners-page interaction remain unchanged by identifying the NFT mint number as the referral code.
The referral-code metadata source does not change Chainlink VRF, selection eligibility, ticket weighting, or on-chain winner selection.
